title: Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services — Tier Placement by Payer and Discipline
content:
Every plan of care under **Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services** is held in exactly one of six tiers. The tier is set by the payer of the plan's visits and, for the Medicare Part B tiers, by the discipline treated. The schedule below states, for each tier, the payer, the disciplines the plan covers, and the conditions a plan must meet to be placed in that tier.

## Placement schedule

| Tier | Payer of the plan's visits | Disciplines the plan covers | Placement conditions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Physical Therapy Plan of Care | Medicare Part B | Physical therapy | Payer is Medicare Part B; the discipline is physical therapy; the resident is not in a Part A covered stay |
| Medicare Part B Occupational Therapy Plan of Care | Medicare Part B | Occupational therapy | Payer is Medicare Part B; the discipline is occupational therapy; the resident is not in a Part A covered stay |
| Medicare Part B Speech-Language Pathology Plan of Care | Medicare Part B | Speech-language pathology | Payer is Medicare Part B; the discipline is speech-language pathology; the resident is not in a Part A covered stay |
| Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care | Medicare Advantage | Any discipline | Payer is Medicare Advantage; the Medicare Advantage plan's authorization is on file |
| Medical Assistance Therapy Plan of Care | Medical Assistance (Medicaid) | Any discipline | Payer is Medical Assistance; prior authorization is on file |
| Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care | Private pay | Any discipline | Payer is private pay |

Every listed condition of a tier must hold for a plan to be placed in it.

## Points of judgement

- **One discipline per Medicare Part B tier.** Under Medicare Part B the discipline decides the tier: physical therapy, occupational therapy and speech-language pathology are each a separate tier. The Medicare Advantage, Medical Assistance and Private Pay tiers each cover any discipline.
- **Part A covered stay.** The three Medicare Part B tiers each require that the resident is not in a Part A covered stay. On a day the resident is in a Part A covered stay, that placement condition is not met.
- **Authorization on file.** The Medicare Advantage tier requires the plan's authorization on file; the Medical Assistance tier requires prior authorization on file. The Private Pay tier names the payer only.

## Illustrations (hypothetical residents)

- A resident whose therapy is paid by Medicare Part B, who is not in a Part A covered stay, and who is referred for occupational therapy fits the Medicare Part B Occupational Therapy Plan of Care.
- A Medicare Part B resident referred for both physical therapy and speech-language pathology meets the conditions of two tiers, one for each discipline: the Medicare Part B Physical Therapy Plan of Care and the Medicare Part B Speech-Language Pathology Plan of Care.
- A resident paying privately and referred for speech-language pathology fits the Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care, which covers any discipline.
- A Medicare Advantage member whose plan authorization is not on file does not meet the placement conditions of the Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care.
